PHARMACY_NAME.expr: 'Farmácia ' + pick(['Silva','Santos','Ferreira','Pereira','Oliveira','Costa','Rodrigues','Martins','Sousa','Fernandes','Gonçalves','Gomes','Lopes','Marques','Alves','Almeida','Ribeiro','Pinto','Carvalho','Teixeira','Moreira','Correia','Mendes','Nunes','Soares','Vieira','Monteiro','Cardoso','Rocha','Neves','Coelho','Cruz','Cunha','Pires','Ramos','Reis','Simões','Antunes','Matos','Fonseca','Central','Moderna','Avenida','do Mercado','da Sé','Nova','São João','Estrela','Saúde','do Carmo','Lusitana','Popular']) + ' ' + r['DISTRICT'] + ' ' + str(rng.randint(1, 99))

columns.name: THERAPEUTIC_AREA
columns.expr: weighted({'Cardiovascular': 22, 'Alimentary & Metabolism': 17, 'Nervous System': 16, 'Respiratory': 8 * (1.7 if month in (11, 12, 1, 2) else 1), 'Anti-infectives': 6 * (1.5 if month in (12, 1, 2) else 1), 'Musculo-skeletal': 9, 'Dermatological': 6 * (1.3 if month in (6, 7, 8) else 1), 'Consumer Health (OTC)': 16})

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.expr: weighted({'Cardiolis': 62 * (1 - 0.72 * ramp(240)), 'Rosuvastatina Tejo': 14 * (1 + 2.4 * ramp(240)), 'Rosuvastatina Norvia': 12 * (1 + 2.2 * ramp(240)), 'Rosuvastatina Solmed': 6 * (1 + 3.0 * ramp(240)), 'Atorvastatina Tejo': 6}) if r['PRODUCT_BASE'] == 'Cardiolis' else r['PRODUCT_BASE']

columns.name: MANUFACTURER
columns.expr: 'Tejo Generics' if 'Tejo' in r['PRODUCT'] else 'Norvia Labs' if 'Norvia' in r['PRODUCT'] else 'Solmed Genéricos' if 'Solmed' in r['PRODUCT'] else {'Cardiolis':'Atlântica Pharma','Tensivar':'Atlântica Pharma','Betacord':'Bracara Health','Calcivas':'Bracara Health','Glicora':'Medilusa','Insulvia Pen':'Medilusa','Gastrolis':'Atlântica Pharma','Vitalusa D3':'Lusovita','Calcimed':'Lusovita','Serenil':'Bracara Health','Calmazol':'Medilusa','Dorflex Atlântica':'Atlântica Pharma','Respirol Inhaler':'Bracara Health','Brontix Ellipta':'Medilusa','Alergil':'Atlântica Pharma','Tussilar':'Lusovita','Amoxiclav Atlântica':'Atlântica Pharma','Flexidor':'Bracara Health','Dermacort':'Medilusa','Hidraderm':'Dermalusa','Atopicalm':'Dermalusa','Febrinol':'Lusovita','Ben-u-dor':'Lusovita','Gripexil':'Lusovita','Tussilar Junior':'Lusovita','Digestil':'Dermalusa','Probiolusa':'Dermalusa','Vitalusa Multi':'Lusovita','Magnesium Plus':'Lusovita'}.get(r['PRODUCT'], 'Atlântica Pharma')

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.expr: 'OTC Brand' if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] == 'Consumer Health (OTC)' else 'Generic' if ('Tejo' in r['PRODUCT'] or 'Norvia' in r['PRODUCT'] or 'Solmed' in r['PRODUCT']) else 'Originator Brand'

columns.name: MARKET_SEGMENT
columns.expr: 'Consumer Health' if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] == 'Consumer Health (OTC)' else 'Non-Reimbursed Rx' if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] == 'Dermatological' and chance(0.6) else 'Reimbursed Rx'

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_TIER
columns.expr: 'Not Reimbursed' if r['MARKET_SEGMENT'] != 'Reimbursed Rx' else ('Tier A (90%)' if r['ATC_CLASS'].startswith(('A10', 'R03')) else 'Tier B (69%)' if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] in ('Cardiovascular', 'Nervous System', 'Anti-infectives') else 'Tier C (37%)')

columns.name: PRESCRIBER_SPECIALTY
columns.expr: 'No Prescription (OTC)' if r['MARKET_SEGMENT'] == 'Consumer Health' else weighted({'General Practice': 62, {'Cardiovascular':'Cardiology','Alimentary & Metabolism':'Endocrinology','Nervous System':'Psychiatry','Respiratory':'Pulmonology','Anti-infectives':'Internal Medicine','Musculo-skeletal':'Orthopaedics','Dermatological':'Dermatology'}[r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA']]: 28, 'Internal Medicine': 10})

columns.name: PATIENT_AGE_BAND
columns.expr: weighted({'0-17': 5 if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] in ('Cardiovascular','Alimentary & Metabolism') else 14, '18-39': 16, '40-64': 34, '65-79': 30 if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] == 'Cardiovascular' else 22, '80+': 14})

columns.name: UNITS_DEMANDED
columns.expr: 1 + int(lognorm(1.6, 0.7)) + (1 if r['ATC_CLASS'].startswith(('C', 'A10')) and chance(0.35) else 0)

columns.name: STOCK_STATUS
columns.expr: weighted({'Out of Stock': 0.025 + (0.20 * ramp(130) if r['ATC_CLASS'].startswith('R03') and r['REGION'] == 'Norte' else 0) + (0.03 if r['THERAPEUTIC_AREA'] == 'Respiratory' and month in (12, 1, 2) else 0), 'Low Stock': 0.07 + (0.10 * ramp(130) if r['ATC_CLASS'].startswith('R03') and r['REGION'] == 'Norte' else 0), 'In Stock': 0.9})

columns.name: UNITS_SOLD
columns.expr: 0 if r['STOCK_STATUS'] == 'Out of Stock' else (max(1, r['UNITS_DEMANDED'] - rng.randint(0, 1)) if r['STOCK_STATUS'] == 'Low Stock' else r['UNITS_DEMANDED'])

columns.name: UNFILLED_RX_FLAG
columns.expr: 1 if r['UNFILLED_UNITS'] > 0 and r['MARKET_SEGMENT'] != 'Consumer Health' else 0

columns.name: STOCK_ON_HAND_UNITS
columns.expr: 0 if r['STOCK_STATUS'] == 'Out of Stock' else rng.randint(1, 3) if r['STOCK_STATUS'] == 'Low Stock' else rng.randint(6, 48)

post.name: ALERT_ID
post.expr: r['ALERT_ID'] if r['ALERT_STATUS'] != 'No Alert' else None

post.name: ALERT_DATE
post.expr: r['ALERT_DATE'] if r['ALERT_STATUS'] != 'No Alert' else None

post.name: DAYS_OPEN
post.expr: age if r['ALERT_STATUS'] in ('Open', 'In Review') else None
